title: How To Do Bicep Curls: One Arm or Both Arms?
hook: There are two ways to do bicep curls.
body: One arm at a time with a twist of the wrist, or both arms together. Both arms together gives you a little less range of motion, and some beginners find it harder to keep good form that way.
close: Try it both ways. Whichever works best for you is perfectly valid.
